nome_jp: ボルシャック・大和・ドラゴン 「開眼」
testo:
Speed Attacker
Powered Breaker
■ While attacking, this creature gets +1000 power for each Samurai in your graveyard.
■ Whenever one of your opponent's creatures is destroyed by the effect of one of your cards that has "Musha" in its name, choose one of your opponent's creatures that has power 12000 or less and destroy it.
